messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify once, queue Rx 7004512 at H-302, give a ready time, done in about 3 to 5 agent turns.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, March 14th, 1995, refill on Rx 7004512, the sertraline, at the Main St University store.
    (agent system action #2: verify_identity({"patient":"Jamal Carter","dob":"March 14, 1995"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Jamal Carter","home_store":"H-302","default_store":"H-302","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #5: queue_refill({"rx":"7004512","store":"H-302"}) -> success {"status":"queued","rx_id":"7004512","store_id":"H-302","ready_time":"2026-09-25T10:00"})
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then queue that refill for you. Great, I've verified you. Now let me queue that sertraline refill at the Main St University store for you. Perfect! Your sertraline refill is queued and will be ready tomorrow, Friday the 25th, at ten in the morning at the Main St University store.
CALLER: Great, thanks, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S02.judged.1: Gives a ready time.
S02.judged.2: Re-asks for name, DOB, Rx number or store after Jamal gave them in the opening line.
S02.judged.3: Adds unrequested counseling or safety messaging about sertraline.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S02.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent states ready time as tomorrow at ten in the morning."}, "S02.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent did not re-ask any info, proceeded directly with verification and queuing."}, "S02.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 9, "why": "Agent gave no counseling or safety messaging about sertraline, just confirmed queuing."}}
